summary: The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed one line, in `solution/core.py` at line 12: the overlap/containment branch of `merge` set the merged interval's end to the new interval's end `b`, not to the larger of the two ends. When a later interval sat inside the previous one, the containing interval got shrunk, which is why `(1, 4), (2, 3)` came out as `(1, 3)`. It now uses `max(pb, b)`. I didn't touch `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `merge` signature. I also spot-checked a few edge cases (nested intervals, touching intervals with and without `join_touching`, duplicate points, empty input), and they behave as expected. The touching-but-not-joined logic and the rest of the function are unchanged.
